name: Nishigō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nishigō village emblem in red: a disc pierced by three white curved strokes, like a triskele.
history: Municipal flag of Nishigō, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1967.

features.role: Nishigō village emblem — a disc pierced by three white curved strokes, like a triskele
